title: Embedded System Plate Number Recognition
description: Advanced computer vision system utilizing YOLO for real-time object detection, deployed on embedded hardware for efficient license plate recognition.
longDescription: Real-time license plate recognition system using YOLO, OCR, OpenCV, and Python deployed on embedded hardware.

title: Plate Number Recognition
description: Web-based license plate recognition system with Flask backend and real-time processing capabilities.
longDescription: Flask-based web application capable of detecting and recognizing vehicle license plates in real time.

title: Gun Detection System
description: Security-focused computer vision application for real-time weapon detection and alert systems.
longDescription: AI-powered computer vision system that detects firearms using YOLO and provides real-time monitoring.

title: IoT Smart Helmet for Riders
description: A smart safety system designed to track riders in real time, enabling location monitoring, data logging, and improved emergency response through a connected web dashboard.
longDescription: IoT-based rider safety system using ESP32 with GPS tracking, GPRS communication, and FastAPI backend.

title: Uniform Detection with Fingerprint Attendance System
description: An automated attendance system that ensures compliance and accuracy by verifying uniforms using AI vision and authenticating users through fingerprint scanning.
longDescription: Attendance monitoring system using AI-based uniform detection and fingerprint authentication.

title: Wedding Invitation Website
description: My responsive wedding website features event information, RSVP functionality, a photo gallery, a countdown timer, venue location, and a modern user interface to provide guests with a seamless and memorable experience.
longDescription: Responsive wedding invitation website with RSVP, countdown timer, gallery, and venue map.

title: Tissue Package Defect Detection
